what: NER 'shares-entity' edges (spaCy, NO LLM) vs synthetic kNN edges. L3 budget-matched PPR recall@100 from dense-top-20 seeds. Edge weight = sum(1/entity_df) so rare-entity BRIDGES beat common-entity HUBS.
conclusions: NER edges >> kNN edges everywhere: text NER-only 87-93 vs kNN 79-81; KB NER 87.8 vs kNN 34.9 (kNN ~ dense on KB = useless).
DROP kNN: redundant on text (adds ~0 over struct+NER) and worthless on KB.
Specificity weighting (1/df) fixes the clique-hub dilution: 2wiki struct+NER 96.5->98.8, metaqa @100 92.8->97.5, @50 80.8->85.2.
BEST UNIVERSAL EDGE-SET = struct + weighted-NER. vs current struct+kNN @100: musique +4.2, 2wiki +2.8, metaqa +4.4 (@50 +18); hotpot -1.5 (near-ceiling).
SPLADE-redundancy (open, next phase): on MetaQA NER-traversal reaches ~the same golds SPLADE recovered (both ~87) -> plausibly redundant on KB; needs full-pipeline retrain+benchmark to confirm.
next: Add weighted-NER as a UKB edge type, remove kNN, retrain heads/adapter, re-benchmark end-to-end; then ablate SPLADE.
